title: External Application Accuracy Contract and Runtime Policy Seam Qualification Evidence

contract_result.H_app_semantics: positive finite externally supplied and externally qualified application prediction-accuracy requirement with positive provenance id
contract_result.A_temporal_semantics: positive finite externally qualified allocation fraction with positive provenance id and 0 < A_temporal <= 1
contract_result.stale_carrier_policy: clear availability and value before attempting materialization so an invalid or incomplete new contract cannot retain an earlier application-owned budget
contract_result.absence_policy: explicitly unavailable; never infer a positive budget

source_bound_gates.source_allowlist: PASS: relative to F-GC08, src/ contains only src/runtime/mod_coupling_application_accuracy_contract.f90

red_to_green_provenance.head: 371f352b7274adacb1d188679ec4a1e91947db77
red_to_green_provenance.finding: The qualification test used direct REAL equality comparisons while compiling the test with -Werror; gfortran promoted -Wcompare-reals warnings to errors.
red_to_green_provenance.remediation: Replace warning-producing REAL equality checks with warning-clean finite/value checks without relaxing scientific or contract semantics.

red_to_green_provenance.head: 45e1bcc2bcc180d00aabc337f340226e3ec1baf7
red_to_green_provenance.finding: Under -ffpe-trap=invalid, a NaN contract input triggered SIGFPE because Fortran does not guarantee short-circuit evaluation of .and.; ieee_is_finite(x) being false did not guarantee that x > 0 would not also be evaluated.
red_to_green_provenance.remediation: Rewrite floating-point validation as explicit sequential guards before relational comparisons.

red_to_green_provenance.head: 4ab9b2e94b0460a1c488f259f981951ad49efc09
red_to_green_provenance.finding: The runtime defect was fixed, but the shell gate still searched for the old textual form 'A_temporal <= 1' and therefore rejected the equivalent trap-safe guard 'if (A_temporal > 1) return'.
red_to_green_provenance.remediation: Align the source-structure gate with the trap-safe implementation form while retaining the same 0 < A_temporal <= 1 semantic requirement.

red_to_green_provenance.head: 7ddc4fd6970fc72ffe064ce074341d1166eea0ae
red_to_green_provenance.finding: All source-bound, runtime matrix, fail-closed, stale-clearing and O0/O2 identity gates passed under bounds/runtime checks and floating-point traps.
